output.subject: quick thought on modeler launch
output.body:
I saw that Abacum announced on 13 October that you launched Modeler, an AI agent that brings Agentic Modeling to finance teams.
As you scale Modeler, building a rapid, targeted outbound pipeline without expanding SDR headcount could be a challenge, especially as generic sequences see declining reply rates.
Our outbound pipeline engine surfaces buying signals, finds the right contacts, and drafts researched, cited first‑touch emails that your reps can review, helping growth teams add pipeline without hiring more SDRs.
Would you be open to a 15‑minute call to explore if this approach fits your Modeler rollout?
Priyanshu
